ability.infinity.time_stone.climate_zone: Left: mark an area at the aimed point (radius on Alt+scroll, 6–24) with an animated green outline. Right: menu of climates that apply ONLY inside the area, to everyone there: Storm (black cloud, heavy rain and real lightning), Rain, Snow (thin snow and freezing edge water with mobGriefing), Fog, Scorching Sun (fire on anyone without a helmet after 5 s, crops grow), Aurora (Regeneration I), Sandstorm and Clear Sky (ends it). Lasts 3 min; one zone per player.
ability.infinity.time_stone.stasis_bubbl: Left: a green dome of clocks at the aimed point for 8 s (radius 3–8 on Alt+scroll). Inside, time STOPS for everyone but you and your allies: mobs freeze in mid-air, projectiles hang, players cannot move, falls and fire stop. All damage dealt to the frozen is stored and lands at once when the bubble breaks. Right: pop your bubble. Bosses are immune.
ability.infinity.time_stone.time_mark.de: Left: mark the aimed creature (or yourself); right: mark yourself. A green hourglass floats above the marked one. Use again to rewind (or wait 10 s): it returns to exactly that instant along a trail of green ghosts. Allies (and you) also get their health, fire and hunger back; enemies only their position.
Left: a FAST field at the aimed point for 30 s; right: a SLOW field. Speed ×2–×10 on Alt+scroll. Fast: plants, saplings, copper, furnaces, blast furnaces, smokers, campfires, brewing stands and baby animals run N times faster; anyone inside gets Speed and Haste. Slow: mobs, players and projectiles of non-allies run at 1/N speed.
ability.infinity.time_stone.eras.title: Eras
ability.infinity.time_stone.eras.descrip: Left: age the aimed area; right: rejuvenate it (radius 2–6 on Alt+scroll). A green wave sweeps through: Aging cracks and moss-covers stone and bricks, oxidises copper, chips anvils, ripens crops, grows saplings into trees and babies into adults, and wears dropped tools. Rejuvenating does the opposite. Nothing is destroyed.
Time + Reality conjunction. Left: undo the explosions of the last 5 min around you (radius 8–32 on Alt+scroll) in green and red waves: blocks destroyed by creepers, TNT, ghasts, withers... fly back into place with their original state (only where the spot is still empty). Items the explosion dropped that are still on the ground are taken back.
infinity.extra.time.climate.storm.desc: Black cloud, heavy rain and real lightning inside the area.
infinity.extra.time.climate.rain.desc: Rain over the area only; puts out anyone burning inside.
infinity.extra.time.climate.snow.desc: Flakes and slowness; thin snow on the ground and freezing edge water (mobGriefing).
infinity.extra.time.climate.fog.desc: A dense curtain: those inside can barely see.
infinity.extra.time.climate.sun.desc: Heat waves; fire on anyone without a helmet after 5 s; crops grow.
infinity.extra.time.climate.aurora.desc: Green and blue bands in the sky; Regeneration I for those inside.
infinity.extra.time.climate.sand.desc: Swirling sand, poor sight, slowness and fatigue.
infinity.extra.time.climate.marked: Climate zone marked (radius %s). Right: pick the climate.
infinity.extra.time.climate.ending: The climate zone fades in 10 s.
infinity.extra.time.climate.hot: The sun burns! Put on a helmet.
infinity.extra.time.mark.marked_you: An hourglass has marked your instant...
infinity.extra.time.mark.rewound: %s went back to the marked instant.
infinity.extra.time.restore.nothing: Nothing to restore here (explosions of the last 5 min).
infinity.extra.time.restore.need_reality: You also need the Reality Stone.
